name: Aomi Labs Task API (Arc Mainnet)
description: Aomi Labs builds the execution harness for onchain finance. Its production Task API lets agents inspect a simulated onchain action before deciding whether to buy the exact unsigned transaction bundle. A valid JSON POST quotes 0.01 USDC for preparation over x402 through Circle Gateway on Arc Mainnet. Status and the signed preview are free. Retrieval is a separate purchase priced at 3% of simulated gross outgoing USDC (free for zero outflow). The buyer's wallet alone signs and broadcasts.
